analysis: The problem requires determining the maximum number of houses that can be painted using only 3 colors, given that no two adjacent houses can have the same color. The total number of houses is 100, and there are 5 different colors available. The constraint that no two adjacent houses can have the same color implies that the sequence of colors must alternate. If we use only 3 colors, the sequence will repeat every 3 houses. Therefore, the maximum number of houses that can be painted using only 3 colors is 99, as the 100th house would have to be the same color as the 1st house, violating the constraint.
